name: Tool - WhatWeb
summary: Identify what software is in use on the specified website.

data_source.description: Identify what software is in use on the specified website.

module_opts.name: ruby_path
module_opts.description: Path to Ruby interpreter to use for WhatWeb. If just 'ruby' then it must be in your $PATH.

module_opts.name: whatweb_path
module_opts.description: Path to the whatweb executable file. Must be set.

tool_details.name: WhatWeb
tool_details.description: WhatWeb identifies websites. Its goal is to answer the question, "What is that Website?". WhatWeb recognises web technologies including content management systems (CMS), blogging platforms, statistic/analytics packages, JavaScript libraries, web servers, and embedded devices. WhatWeb has over 1800 plugins, each to recognise something different. WhatWeb also identifies version numbers, email addresses, account IDs, web framework modules, SQL errors, and more.
